NOT RECORDED in plan.md's wave 63 or in m:wave63-board-footing, which name only the 6 ft offset - a recording gap to close (one clause), not a narrowing.

decisions.summary: 0190's drawing page reworded from 'at city scale' to 'at village and city scale' for the oversized marker, to match the code (two DRIFTED claims now IN-STEP, among them the E4 ranked row board_record#marker floor)
decisions.why: Rewording a page to fit the code is the spec's Edge Cases exception path ('A fix that seems to need the research changed instead ... goes to spec-fidelity with the GM's request verbatim; if it agrees, it is recorded and raised with the GM once the wave works'), so it is ruled here. LEGITIMATE because the scope is already fixed by the GM's own call, not completed by the session: commit f8f07e0ac (2026-07-24) is titled 'the kosatsuba draws as a location marker at village/city grain' and records 'GM call 2026-07-24'; its town-deep-audit note says 'Towns and hamlets (1 ft/px) are unaffected'; the floor the GM approved 'NEVER shrinks a board' and so by its mechanism lifts the 8 px village frame. The page's 'city scale' understated a GM ruling; the alternative the E4 row named (gate the floor to city grain) would undo part of that ruling. The passage is a map drawing convention, not a historical finding, and no kept map (all 1 ft/px) draws differently either way. The E4 row's own ranked fix names this route, and the GM authorized E4 research passes inside the feature (2026-10-08). Owed: the wave's report raises it with the GM (Edge Cases), and the row board_record#marker floor is closed at 63 in ranking.json/waves.json with that authorization named (it still shows wave '').
